IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. DATAORA.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 WS-DATA PIC 9(8).
       01 WS-ORA PIC 9(8).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           ACCEPT WS-DATA FROM DATE YYYYMMDD
           ACCEPT WS-ORA FROM TIME
           DISPLAY "DATA (AAAAMMGG): " WS-DATA
           DISPLAY "ORA (HHMMSSCC): " WS-ORA
           STOP RUN.
